lines.text: And thou art flying to a fresher clime.
lines.plainText: And thou art flying to a fresher clime

lines.text: Look what thy soul holds dear, imagine it
lines.plainText: Look what thy soul holds dear imagine it

lines.text: To lie that way thou goest, not whence thou com'st.
lines.plainText: To lie that way thou goest not whence thou com'st

lines.text: Suppose the singing birds musicians,
lines.plainText: Suppose the singing birds musicians

lines.text: The grass whereon thou tread'st the presence strewed,
lines.plainText: The grass whereon thou tread'st the presence strewed

lines.text: The flowers fair ladies, and thy steps no more
lines.plainText: The flowers fair ladies and thy steps no more

lines.text: Than a delightful measure or a dance;
lines.plainText: Than a delightful measure or a dance

lines.text: For gnarling sorrow hath less power to bite
lines.plainText: For gnarling sorrow hath less power to bite

lines.text: The man that mocks at it and sets it light.
lines.plainText: The man that mocks at it and sets it light

lines.text: O, who can hold a fire in his hand
lines.plainText: O who can hold a fire in his hand

lines.text: By thinking on the frosty Caucasus?
lines.plainText: By thinking on the frosty Caucasus

lines.text: Or cloy the hungry edge of appetite
lines.plainText: Or cloy the hungry edge of appetite

lines.text: By bare imagination of a feast?
lines.plainText: By bare imagination of a feast

lines.text: Or wallow naked in December snow
lines.plainText: Or wallow naked in December snow

lines.text: By thinking on fantastic summer's heat?
lines.plainText: By thinking on fantastic summer's heat

lines.text: O no, the apprehension of the good
lines.plainText: O no the apprehension of the good

lines.text: Gives but the greater feeling to the worse.
lines.plainText: Gives but the greater feeling to the worse

lines.text: Fell sorrow's tooth doth never rankle more
lines.plainText: Fell sorrow's tooth doth never rankle more

lines.text: Than when it bites but lanceth not the sore.
lines.plainText: Than when it bites but lanceth not the sore

lines.text: Come, come, my son, I'll bring thee on thy way.
lines.plainText: Come come my son I'll bring thee on thy way

lines.text: Had I thy youth and cause, I would not stay.
lines.plainText: Had I thy youth and cause I would not stay

lines.text: Then, England's ground, farewell; sweet soil, adieu,
lines.plainText: Then England's ground farewell sweet soil adieu

lines.text: My mother and my nurse that bears me yet!
lines.plainText: My mother and my nurse that bears me yet

lines.text: Where'er I wander, boast of this I can,
lines.plainText: Where'er I wander boast of this I can

lines.text: Though banished, yet a true-born Englishman.
lines.plainText: Though banished yet a trueborn Englishman
